title: Vehicle profile params.yaml (awr.vehicle.v1, schema 1.1)
description: AWR-16 §11.2: every identifiable parameter is {value, conf A-D, src}; conf E values live only in rejected[]. Loader runs VH-1..VH-7 and rejects on failure (353). Keys snake_case with unit suffix; px4_params keeps PX4 names. Schema 1.1 (ADR-115, AWR-20 §7.3): required fields depend on frame.type (multirotor fields for quad_x, hex_x and the VTOL lift system; airframe for fixed_wing and vtol_quadplane); D1 files stay valid; catalog models carry signatures.

size_m.description: bounding box l x w x h, m (D2)

pack_id.description: must be listed in catalog.json packs[]

sensors.description: slot -> mount file; string form = D1 slot (scenario only, not listed by the D2 catalog); object form (D2, AWR-20 §7.4); sensor_no follows the mapping order

sl_a_1m_dba.description: D2.1 (AWR-04 §15.10.2): source level at 1 m = L_WA - 11 (hover, or cruise for fixed wing)

airframe.description: fixed wing and VTOL airframe (AWR-20 §5.1); aerodynamic and energy coefficients as value objects, speeds and angles may be plain numbers

hot_fraction.description: D2.1 (AWR-04 §15.10.2): share of the side projection that is hot (motors, ESC, battery bay)
